decisions.reason: As a small complementary accessory it is easier to discontinue if it falls short, but its continued dedicated page and low carrying cost mean management would likely keep it while results remain uncertain.
A homepage-featured box car trailer series is a core-category launch, and without a clear below-aspiration signal a medium-sized established firm would usually continue it for another year.
The car transporter trailer is more niche and therefore somewhat riskier, but having its own page suggests active support and the firm would likely allow more time before reallocating resources.
The low-bed trailer series was prominently shown on the home page and fits core trailer capabilities, so management would be unlikely to drop it this early.
The high trailer cover series was homepage-promoted and complements the firm's main trailer business, making continued retention more likely than withdrawal.
Although overlap with another box car trailer line raises some rationalisation risk, its homepage prominence indicates enough expected demand for management to keep it for now.
